reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI opportunities with risks of deepening rifts
themes.definition: AI framed as offering great opportunities but, without regulation or guardrails, risking deeper divisions and threats.
themes.inclusion: Passages pairing AI opportunities with risks such as deepening rifts or new threats.
themes.boundary_cases: Opportunity-threat framing of technological advances generally counts if AI is named in the threat list.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence offers up colossal opportunities, but without regulations or ethical guardrails, it risks deepening existing rifts.
technological advances bring new opportunities, but also new threats

themes.label: Humans as masters of technology
themes.definition: Insistence that technology, including AI, must serve humanity and that humans be its masters, not subjects.
themes.inclusion: Passages asserting AI must serve humanity and remain under human mastery.
themes.boundary_cases: Statements that AI should foster peace and dignity without control language fit AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS instead.

examples.quote: We need to be the masters of technology and never its subjects

themes.label: AI should foster peace and dignity
themes.definition: AI should be directed toward peace, development and human dignity, with ethical guardrails.
themes.inclusion: Passages stating technological breakthroughs like AI must foster human dignity or be ethically guarded.
themes.boundary_cases: A brief normative clause in a list of UN priorities counts here.

examples.quote: technological breakthroughs such as artificial intelligence, foster peace, development, and human dignity

themes.label: AI and disinformation threatening democracies
themes.definition: Accelerating AI alongside cyberattacks and disinformation seen as endangering democratic stability.
themes.inclusion: Passages linking AI development to disinformation or threats to democracies.
themes.boundary_cases: A combined list of AI, cyberattacks and disinformation may also take AI_CYBER_SECURITY.

examples.quote: The acceleration of the development of artificial intelligence, the proliferation of cyberattacks and disinformation endanger the stability of democracies around the world.

themes.label: Least connected countries need support
themes.definition: The digital divide leaves least-connected countries like Haiti excluded, requiring support so no one is left behind.
themes.inclusion: Passages on internet access gaps, least connected countries, or no people being left behind technologically.
themes.boundary_cases: Requests for support to bridge the divide may also take AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: Haiti, as one of the least connected countries, must imperatively receive support to bridge the digital divide

value.rationale: All passages are Haitian speeches that treat AI as a dual-edged opportunity requiring guardrails, human mastery and dignity, with 2024 linking AI to disinformation threats and the digital divide.
